views.markdown: Adds a heart button to the lock screen, the Dynamic Island's expanded player, and Control Center (compact and expanded) to like or unlike the currently playing Spotify track, without opening the app.

### 1.9
The heart now only shows up when Spotify is actually the app playing, instead of on any app's now-playing player.

### 1.8
Small update fixing heart positioning.

### 1.7
Added Control Center support, in both compact and expanded views. Also increased the heart icon size everywhere.

### 1.6
Fixed the like button and heart sync breaking on Spotify 9.1.82.

### 1.5
Added the heart to the Dynamic Island's expanded now-playing player.

### 1.4
Fixed the heart dropping out of line when the lock screen player is expanded to full screen (iOS 16).

### 1.3
iOS 17 finally working, plus NextUp3 compatibility

### 1.2
Fixed heart fill state (finally)

### 1.1
Fixed heart state sync, unlike, and dynamic position

### 1.0
Initial release
